title: Kayak Car Rentals Scraper
description: Compare Kayak rental cars with provider, company, vehicle description, quoted price, and booking link. Batch pickup locations and set future collection and return dates.

batch.title: Pickup locations
batch.description: Airport or city pickup codes for KAYAK rental-car searches.
batch.valueDescription: Pickup used to run this search.

schema.description: Airport or city code where the rental car is collected.
Rental car pickup date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Rental car drop-off date in YYYY-MM-DD format after pickup.
Local hour when the rental car is collected.
Local hour when the rental car is returned.
Sort order for returned search results. Accepted values: rank_a, price_a.
Whether quoted prices are shown as totals or per-night or per-person values. Accepted values: total, daily.

relativeDateDefaults.description: When omitted, pickup is set to 30 days from today.
When omitted, drop-off is set to four days after pickup.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Search Kayak rental cars by pickup location and dates. Export providers, vehicle names, quoted prices, and booking links to compare car-hire options.
storeCopy.intro: Search Kayak car rentals by pickup location and travel dates. Collect provider names, vehicle descriptions, quoted prices, and booking links for comparison.
useCases: Travel planners can compare rental-car options for airport pickups.
Car-hire analysts can monitor quoted totals and providers across locations.
Travel agencies can shortlist vehicles for future itineraries.
howToUse: Add an airport or city pickup code to each entry in `pickup_locations`.
Set pickup and drop-off dates or use the relative date defaults.
Choose pickup times, sorting, and total or daily price display.

faqs.question: Can pickup and drop-off times be specified?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use `pickup_hour` and `dropoff_hour` with hour values supported by KAYAK.

fields.name: resultId
fields.description: KAYAK identifier for this car-rental offer.

fields.name: providerName
fields.description: Rental provider name displayed in the offer.

fields.name: companyName
fields.description: Car-hire company associated with the vehicle offer.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Vehicle or rental offer title shown by KAYAK.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Localized price label for the offer.

fields.name: priceData
fields.description: Numeric amount, currency, and period used for the quoted price.

fields.name: clickUrlTemplate
fields.description: KAYAK click-through URL template for the rental offer.

fields.name: isAd
fields.description: True when KAYAK marks the result as an advertisement.

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Position of the offer in the returned search results.

fields.name: input_pickup
fields.description: Pickup location code submitted for the rental-car search.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this record was collected.
